source.title: Lurgan Mail, 10 May 1902, p. 5 ("Lurgan Rural": "the following have been elected unopposed")
source.publisher: Lurgan Mail (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: every name read from the page image; returned unopposed, no poll

note: Triennial election of the rural district council (ten Co. Armagh divisions, two councillors each), 1902: every division returned unopposed. No party labels are printed. Returned unopposed. "As only one candidate was nominated in the Breagh and Kernan divisions, one of the retiring members retains his seat in each case"; the report does not say which of the two named was the one nominated.
